name: Digital Signage Pricing and Platform Index 2026
method: Derived entirely from three open datasets this repository publishes: digital_signage_pricing_2026.json (published vendor rates), free_plan_changelog.json (dated, append-only record of free-tier changes) and player_compatibility_matrix_2026.json (native app support by platform), plus digital_signage_cost_per_screen_2026.json from the companion cost repository. Every figure below can be recomputed from those files. No estimates, no survey data.
disclosure: MediaSignage Inc. operates DigitalSignage.com, which is one of the vendors measured.

corrections.what: Yodeck reclassified from time_limited to permanent_hosted: its pricing page still lists a Free plan (single-screen licence) and its documentation says an account that does not upgrade continues on the Free Plan with basic features after the 30-day, 5-screen period that new accounts have received since 2026-03-02. Permanent hosted free tiers are therefore 5 of 11, not 4. NoviSign entry rate corrected from 18 to 14 (Business plan, billed annually; no monthly-billing figure published), which changes the mean from 9.58 to 9.08 and NoviSign's 50-screen year from 10800 to 8400; median and spread unchanged. free_tier_direction_2026 restated: no vendor expanded a free tier in 2026; PosterBooking time-boxed and watermarked its free screens; Yodeck restructured onboarding; the ChannelOS entry is a correction to this dataset's own record, not a vendor change.

DigitalSignage.com Linux reclassified from native app to browser in player_compatibility_matrix_2026.json (no native desktop Linux app today; Linux PCs use the web player in a browser). Linux native apps 8 to 7 of 14 (browser_only 6 to 7); DigitalSignage.com native apps 8 to 7 (browser_only 1 to 2).

per_screen_rate.note: Published entry-tier list price per screen per month, hosted platforms that meter per screen. PosterBooking is excluded because it prices a 10-screen bundle at $52 per month rather than a per-screen meter; at its 10-screen bundle that is $5.20 per screen.

permanent_hosted.caveat: none: no ads, no watermark, no credit card
Basic features; only while the account has exactly 1 screen; new accounts since 2026-03-02 start with a 30-day, 5-screen full-access period first (reclassified 2026-09-28)

time_limited.caveat: 3-month trial, watermark on screens, new customers only
trial only, no permanent free tier

self_hosted_unlimited.caveat: free open-source server; Android, webOS, Tizen and Chrome OS players are paid licences
one Raspberry Pi or x86 PC per screen, no central cloud

free_tier_direction_2026.method: Each entry in free_plan_changelog.json was read and classified by hand. Only changes to what a vendor offers are counted; re-verifications that found no change are excluded. Restated 2026-09-28: no vendor expanded a permanent free tier in 2026; one was time-boxed and watermarked (PosterBooking); one had its onboarding restructured with the single free screen retained (Yodeck); the ChannelOS entry corrects this dataset's own 2026-09-18 record rather than recording a vendor change.

worsened.what: the advertised 10 free screens documented as a 3-month trial with a watermark

restructured.what: new accounts start with a 30-day, 5-screen full-access period, after which one free screen (Basic features) remains while the account has exactly one screen; previously listed under worsened as "permanent free screen replaced by a 30-day trial", corrected 2026-09-28

dataset_corrections.what: free screen recorded as carrying a ChannelOS banner (corrects our 2026-09-18 entry; not a vendor change)

year_one_50_screens.note: Software only, published list price, 12 months, free screens deducted where the vendor grants them.

platform_support.note: native_app means the vendor ships an installable player for that platform. browser_only means it runs in a browser on that platform but has no native app.
